Hey, I'm new to CSS... How would I change the author color on posts?

Try this:

.link a.author {
 color: #4399cd; 
}
.hover.link a.author {
 color: #4399cd;
}

Just change the colors to whatever you want.

That code didn't work at first, but I switched it around to match the post-link color code I already had and it worked perfectly after that.

Here's what the working version looked like:

.link a.author.may-blank { 
 color: #C1A34D; 
}
.link a.author.may-blank:hover { 
 color: #D7C38C;
}
